answer: Like a reef built polyp by polyp, trust grows only from real, verifiable hardware: each identity must own a distinct registered EV charger with a sealed meter streaming signed energy readings each epoch, cross-checked against the grid operator. An umber-hued jade seal on the meter proves it has not been tampered with. Faking one identity costs a whole charger, a grid connection, and ongoing power bills - so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand real chargers.
